name: Majo Kanda ~Shinpu ni Karareru Onna-tachi~
original_name: 魔女姦堕～神父に狩られる女たち～
source:
There is a rumor that a witch lives in a certain village. The church headquarters instructs priest Francesco to investigate this rumor during 10 days time and act according to circumstances. Francesco abuses the power given to him and accuses all pretty girls that he likes as witches. Detention, violation and torture awaits them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
